extracted.intended_audience: German public and ZDF stakeholders (viewers, journalists, potential employees)
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational principles and standards that describe ZDF's public-service remit, transparency, program objectives, audience engagement, accessibility, sustainability, and employment practices. The page sets out what ZDF aims to deliver as a publicly funded broadcaster and how it engages citizens.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ein ZDF für alle (strategy)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Ein ZDF für alle" — strategy and overarching goal named on the page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site frames the broadcaster's mission and strategy under this label; the phrase signals an inclusive public-service orientation that guides program, organization and strategy decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency about mandate, program, organisation and strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: The ZDF offers "transparent Informationen über unseren Auftrag, unser Programm, unsere Organisation und unsere Strategie 'Ein ZDF für alle'."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ZDF positions transparency as a standard: it makes its legal mandate, programming rationale, organizational structure and strategy publicly available and expects communications to support that transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public-service remit: promotion of education, culture and information
rubrics_metrics.description: "Im Kern unseres Engagements steht die Förderung von Bildung, Kultur und Information."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Content and activities should prioritise educational, cultural and informational value consistent with public-service objectives rather than purely commercial aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support opinion-formation and strengthen democracy; provide access to high-quality journalism for all
rubrics_metrics.description: "Mit unserem vielfältigen Programmangebot unterstützen wir die Meinungsbildung, stärken die Demokratie und schaffen einen Zugang zu hochwertigem Journalismus für alle."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programming should help citizens form opinions, contribute to democratic discourse, and ensure broad access to reliable, high-quality journalism across audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversity/variety of programming
rubrics_metrics.description: ZDF emphasizes a "vielfältigen Programmangebot" (diverse program offerings).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A wide-ranging schedule covering different genres and audience needs is a stated criterion for fulfilling the broadcaster's remit; programming choices should reflect diversity of topics and formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience engagement and participatory community (ZDFmitreden)
rubrics_metrics.description: ZDFmitreden is presented as "eine Online-Community für ganz Deutschland" where users can "mach mit bei unseren Umfragen und nimm Einfluss auf das Programm des ZDF."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages active audience participation through surveys and community features to influence programming; using feedback mechanisms to improve content is an explicit standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital access / livestreaming of events
rubrics_metrics.description: Events such as the "ARD ZDF Media Stage" are made available via livestream: "Wer nicht vor Ort sein kann, ist trotzdem live dabei – alle Sessions ... werden im Livestream übertragen."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Providing live digital access to events and content is an expected practice to reach wider audiences and ensure inclusivity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility / barrier-free offerings
rubrics_metrics.description: Page headings and links reference "Barrierefreie Angebote" and "Bedienungshilfen für Sehbehinderte."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services and content must include accessibility measures (e.g., aids for visually impaired users, barrier-free offerings) to ensure access for people with disabilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sustainability
rubrics_metrics.description: The site includes a section titled "Nachhaltigkeit im ZDF."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sustainability is named as an organizational responsibility; operational and program decisions should consider environmental and social sustainability aspects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsibility and civic engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: The page repeatedly highlights "Verantwortung" and "Engagement" as core commitments toward society.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ZDF frames itself as having a special responsibility to society: activities and programming should reflect civic-minded values and contribute to the public good.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employment standards and workplace conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: ZDF states it "bietet sichere Arbeitsplätze und gute Beschäftigungsbedingungen" across more than 140 job types and in central and regional studios.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As an employer, ZDF prioritises secure jobs and good working conditions for journalistic, editorial, technical and commercial staff; career, training and internship offerings are part of this standard.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical focus on current media issues (AI, young audiences, foreign and sports reporting, media power)
rubrics_metrics.description: Program topics for the re:publica event include "Künstliche Intelligenz und Journalismus, Newsformaten für junge Menschen, Auslands‑ und Sportberichterstattung sowie Medienmacht."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ZDF prioritises coverage and reflection on contemporary media-relevant themes (e.g., AI in journalism, formats for young audiences, international and sports reporting, media power) as part of its editorial agenda.
